long_biography.plain_text:
BIC Trust places Yim Leak at the intersection of Cambodia's finance and property sectors. As chairman, he guides a licensed trustee business serving commercial trusts, collective investment schemes and asset custody, while a separate executive team handles daily management. His wider governance roles show how real estate and regulated financial services fit within the same business network.

Leak also chairs BIC Bank and is named as a shareholder in its audited accounts. His property roles include One Central Tower and U. Property Management, with the Beong Snor mixed-use development providing a visible example of that work. Together these positions define an ownership-and-governance model spanning banking, trust services and urban development without making him the operating chief of each company.
